note: Candidate contract data only. No aliases are installed, no resolution is changed, and no commands are wired in Phase 1. Phase 3a installs the aliases; Phase 3d wires the commands.

catalog_aliases.typescript6_alias_note: The 'typescript' package name is aliased to @typescript/typescript6@6.0.2 so compiler-API consumers (typescript-eslint, ts-node, tsup, tsconfck) resolve the compatibility API. This alias is applied in pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides or catalog, NOT per-package, to avoid ambiguous resolution.
catalog_aliases.typescript7_alias_note: TypeScript 7.0.2 is installed under a separate 'typescript7' alias that exposes the native tsc binary via a bin script or direct path. Workspace check-types scripts invoke the TS 7 binary explicitly.
catalog_aliases.resolution_rule: No floating major ranges. Both aliases are exact-pinned. pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides.typescript currently pins 5.9.3; Phase 3a replaces this with the typescript6 alias and adds the typescript7 alias.

commands.check-types:parity: pnpm run check-types:compat && pnpm run check-types:native && <parity-harness-compare>

command_notes.check-types:native: Invokes the TypeScript 7 binary via the typescript7 alias. Used by required check-types gates after Phase 3d cutover.
command_notes.check-types:compat: Invokes the TypeScript 6 binary via the 'typescript' package (aliased to @typescript/typescript6). Used as the compatibility/fallback path.
command_notes.check-types:parity: Runs both compilers and compares normalized diagnostics modulo diagnostic-parity-ledger.json. Phase 2 implements the harness; Phase 3c reconciles.
command_notes.check-types:rollback: One-command fallback to TypeScript 6. Switches required checks back to TS 6 without reverting unrelated configuration correctness fixes.

turbo_cache_inputs.note: turbo.json check-types task currently has no explicit inputs beyond dependsOn. Phase 3i requires adding inputs for compiler version hash, tsconfig path hash, and --checkers value so a TS 7 -> TS 6 -> TS 7 cycle busts the cache.

tools_must_remain_on_ts6: tsup (programmatic API consumer for declaration emit)
Any consumer proven by Phase 2 smoke harness to embed the TypeScript programmatic API
